name: sqlite
description: SQLite database engine with command-line tools for database management and analysis

tools.description: Compare and display differences between two SQLite database files
tools.usage:
sqldiff database1.db database2.db # Compare databases
sqldiff --summary db1.db db2.db # Summary of differences
sqldiff --changeset changes.db db1.db db2.db # Generate changeset
sqldiff --table users db1.db db2.db # Compare specific table

tools.description: SQLite command-line shell for database operations and queries
tools.usage:
sqlite3 database.db # Open database
sqlite3 -header -csv database.db 'SELECT * FROM users;' # CSV output
sqlite3 database.db < schema.sql # Execute SQL file
sqlite3 -bail database.db '.dump' > backup.sql # Create backup
sqlite3 ':memory:' # In-memory database

tools.description: Analyze SQLite database structure and provide detailed storage statistics
tools.usage:
sqlite3_analyzer database.db # Full database analysis
sqlite3_analyzer database.db > report.txt # Save analysis report
sqlite3_analyzer --help # Show available options

tools.description: Synchronize SQLite databases over network connections with incremental updates
tools.usage:
sqlite3_rsync client.db server_url # Sync local to remote
sqlite3_rsync --server database.db # Run as sync server
sqlite3_rsync --download remote.db local.db # Download from remote
sqlite3_rsync --verbose client.db server # Verbose sync operation
